app.description: Your self-hosted board-game shelf and game-night picker.

auth.signUpDescription: Enter your details to get started.
auth.bootstrapDescription: Set up the first account. It will have full administrator access.
auth.name: Name
auth.passwordHelp: Use 12–128 characters. A unique password from a password manager is best.

common.duration: {hours, plural, =0 {{minutes} min} other {{hours} h{minutes, plural, =0 {} other { {minutes} min}}}}

dashboard.title: Hi, {name}.
dashboard.description: Here’s a quick look at your collection.
dashboard.emptyBody: Search for a title or import your BGG collection to begin.

collection.title: Your collection
collection.emptyBody: Use “Add a game” above to start building your collection.
collection.otherExpansionsBody: Their matching base game is not currently on this shelf.
collection.count: {count, plural, one {# game, ready for the table.} other {# games, ready for the table.}}

game.removeBody: This removes the game and its personal rating, notes, favorite, and purchase price from your collection.
game.giftedHelp: Gifted games count as having a recorded price, without adding to your spending total.

add.selectedBody: Add the details Board Games Tracker needs for your shelf and picker.
add.searchBody: Discover a BGG page, then save the game locally.
add.searchBodyWithUrl: Type a title or paste a BoardGameGeek game URL. Search starts automatically after three characters.
add.descriptionPlaceholder: A short description for your local catalog

search.tooMany: Too many searches. Try again in a minute.
search.terms: Enter at least three characters or a BGG game URL.

import.title: Import from BoardGameGeek
import.body: Export your collection as CSV on BGG, then upload it here. Board Games Tracker imports owned games, ratings, notes, categories, and mechanics, and securely stores matching BGG cover art in PostgreSQL.
import.limit: Maximum 5 MB and 2,000 rows. Existing matches are updated; games not marked as owned are ignored.

play.title: Choose a game
play.description: Set the table, narrow the shelf, and give the wheel a spin.

picker.emptyBody: Add a game to your collection first, then come back for the big decision.
picker.possibleGames: {count, plural, one {# possible game} other {# possible games}}
picker.possibleGamesDescription: {count, plural, =0 {No games match the current filters.} one {Choose the matching game directly.} other {Browse all # games matching your filters.}}
picker.noFit: No game fits. Relax one of the filters.
picker.match: {count, plural, one {# game matches} other {# games match}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your account, currency, imports, exports, and local data.
settings.name: Name
settings.session: Sessions are stored server-side, rotate automatically, and expire after 14 days. Use Sign out in the sidebar to revoke this session.
settings.currencyBody: Used for purchase prices and collection totals.

wishlist.title: Your wishlist
wishlist.emptyBody: Save games you are considering, then move them into your collection when you buy them.
wishlist.purchaseBody: The game will leave your wishlist and become part of your owned collection.
wishlist.removeBody: This only removes the saved wishlist item.
wishlist.count: {count, plural, one {# game you may want to buy.} other {# games you may want to buy.}}

stats.title: Stats
stats.description: See where your budget went and what kinds of games define your shelf.
stats.noData: Add more collection details to unlock this chart.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Export a backup or merge a previous Board Games Tracker export.
data.exportBody: Includes your collection, wishlist, prices, notes, ratings, preferences, and game metadata. Passwords and sessions are never exported.
data.importBody: Upload a JSON, CSV, XLSX, or SQL export created here. Existing games are updated and other games remain in place.
data.invalid: This is not a valid Board Games Tracker data export.
data.tooLarge: The import must be no larger than 10 MB.
data.unsupported: Choose a JSON, CSV, XLSX, or SQL file.
data.bggBody: Use an official BGG collection CSV as a one-way source.

clear.title: Clear collection
clear.body: Remove every owned game, rating, favorite, note, and purchase price from your collection. Your wishlist, account, and other users are not affected.
clear.warning: This cannot be undone. Type {confirmation} below to confirm. Shared game information and cached covers remain available to other users.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Manage access, review system activity, and monitor the application.
admin.deleteBody: This permanently deletes the account, active sessions, collection entries, and personal data. This cannot be undone.
admin.loadError: The audit events could not be loaded.

error.title: Something knocked over the board.
error.body: No private details were shown. Try this view again; an administrator can inspect the structured server logs if it continues.

notFound.title: This tile isn’t on the board.
notFound.body: The page may have moved, or someone packed it into the wrong box.

action.itemMissing: This collection item was not found.
action.chooseCsv: Choose a BoardGameGeek CSV export up to 5 MB.
action.invalidCsv: The file is not a supported BoardGameGeek collection export.
action.noOwned: No owned games were found in this export.
action.imported: Imported {games} owned games with {artwork} database-cached covers.
action.chooseGame: Choose the game again before adding it.
action.alreadyOwned: This game is already in your collection.
action.movedToCollection: The game is now in your collection.
action.confirmClear: Type {confirmation} to confirm clearing your collection.
action.cleared: {count, plural, one {Removed # game from your collection.} other {Removed # games from your collection.}}
